result.summary: This is a typical residential street with sidewalks on both sides and mature tree cover providing shade. While the environment appears low-speed, it lacks formal pedestrian crossings, traffic calming, or buffers between the walkway and the roadway.

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from parked vehicles
hazards.description: Parked cars along the left curb block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians who might attempt to cross the street.

hazards.name: Lack of designated crossing
hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks visible along this stretch of residential street, requiring pedestrians to cross unprotected.

interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at potential crossing points to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add marked crosswalks with high-visibility patterns to designate safe crossing locations.

interventions.title: Speed Cushions
interventions.description: Implement traffic calming measures like speed cushions to maintain low vehicle speeds in this residential context.

result.summary: The image shows a residential street with a wide, continuous sidewalk and a clear curb. However, the environment lacks pedestrian-scale lighting, street trees, or other physical buffers between the walkway and the roadway.

hazards.name: Lack of sidewalk buffer
hazards.description: There is no physical separation such as a planting strip or parked cars between the sidewalk and the travel lane.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb line in the foreground

hazards.name: Absence of street lighting
hazards.description: No street light poles are visible, which may create safety issues for pedestrians at night.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping
interventions.description: Install street trees or a planting strip to provide a physical and psychological buffer between pedestrians and vehicles.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Add street lighting to improve visibility and personal security for pedestrians after dark.

interventions.title: Lane Markings
interventions.description: Add painted lane markings to better define the roadway and potentially narrow the perceived travel lane to slow traffic.

result.summary: A residential street with continuous sidewalks on both sides and a mature tree canopy providing shade. While the environment is generally walkable, it lacks formal crossing infrastructure and traffic calming measures, with parked vehicles potentially obstructing sightlines.

result.summary: The image shows a typical urban residential street with a continuous, well-maintained sidewalk directly adjacent to the curb. While the environment is generally walkable, it lacks a dedicated buffer between pedestrians and the roadway, and parked vehicles may limit visibility for those crossing.

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian-vehicle buffer
hazards.description: The sidewalk is directly adjacent to the curb with no planting strip or physical barrier separating pedestrians from moving traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the entire length of the visible sidewalk edge.

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from parked vehicles
hazards.description: Parked cars can obscure pedestrians, particularly children, from the view of oncoming drivers if they attempt to cross the street.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image where the blue SUV is parked.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planters
interventions.description: Adding a furniture or planting zone between the sidewalk and the curb to provide a physical and psychological buffer from traffic.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restricting parking near potential crossing points to improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.
